product.description: Enjoy the benefits of our Low Rate Credit Card and receive up to 62 days interest free days on purchases or take advantage of our balance transfer offer.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Membership: You must be or become a Beyond Bank Australia member

Must be an Australian citizen, Permanent Australian resident or hold a Visa - if a Visa holders' income is relied upon to determine serviceability, the term of the Visa must exceed the term of the loan. An Australian resident is a person who is living in Australia and is an Australian citizen, a permanent visa holder, or a protected Special Category visa (SCV) holder.

features.additionalValue: The Annual Card Fee will be waived for eligible Total Home Loan Package borrowers. Conditions apply.

features.additionalInfo: Access your money 24/7 through Internet Banking, Telephone Banking or Mobile Banking services

lendingRates.additionalInfo: For a limited time, this offer is available on balance transfers for a 12 month period with any newly approved Low Rate Visa Credit Card. It applies exclusively to balance transfers from credit cards not issued by Beyond Bank. A minimum transfer amount of $500 is required, and the offer must be requested within one month of your credit card being funded.  After the 12-month promotional period, any remaining balance will revert to the variable interest rate for Purchases applicable at that time. Conditions apply.
